market_curtailment_germany.csv.description: Yearly market-based curtailment of wind and solar in Germany, in TWh, transcribed from the paper: the values its text and its Figure 12 label. Wind is onshore and offshore together.

source.title: Do wind and solar curtail at negative electricity prices? Incentives and evidence across two decades of German renewable support schemes

market_curtailment_germany.csv.method: Market-based curtailment is the generation potential minus actual generation minus grid-related curtailment, summed over the hours with a negative day-ahead price (section 5.1). The potential is fitted on hours with a day-ahead price of 5 EUR/MWh or more and an imbalance price of -50 EUR/MWh or more, from ERA5 100 m wind at twelve onshore and five offshore grid points and surface irradiance. Germany had 573 negative-price hours in 2025 (Table 4).
